description.zh: 看AliceBlue大色块、RGB数值与深浅色阶。 HtmlCssColor是在线颜色参考与工具站，网页工具标注免费，提供取色器、色轮、命名色、随机色和渐变入口。具体颜色页汇集HEX/RGB、深浅色阶与CSS示例，适合查色和取用代码；工具源码、完整许可和商用范围仍未知。
description.en: HtmlCssColor is an online color reference and tool site whose web tools are described as free. It offers a picker, wheel, named and random colors, and gradient links. Individual color pages collect HEX/RGB values, shade and tint scales, and CSS examples. The tool source, complete license and commercial permissions remain unverified.

reconstructionPrompt:
Build a high-quality, production-ready component inspired by HtmlCssColor (https://www.htmlcsscolor.com/).
Technology stack: React, Tailwind CSS, TypeScript.
Component specification: 看AliceBlue大色块、RGB数值与深浅色阶。

Visual details from source observation: 我们先看首页取色栏与免费工具说明，下滚比较命名色、RGB色、Web安全色、随机色、渐变五个入口和色轮。AliceBlue详情实见#F0F8FF、RGB240/248/255与深浅色阶，复制和PNG尺寸链接可见；本次未操作复制、下载或重算换算值。Discover more和绿色扩展下载为广告，不作本站功能；商业复用仍须核许可。
Ensure clean semantic markup, fully accessible ARIA roles and keyboard interactions, responsive layout across desktop and mobile, crisp typography, and fluid state transitions (default, hover, active, focus).
